# Independent reference fixtures

These literal fixtures were authored from the Step 6 Python contracts at
revision `37ae5dd255a0451609e67ad6d6a51fa5de80523c`, independently of Mybots
serialization and response builders. They contain no service credentials.
Dates, IDs, text and fake keys are worked examples, not files generated by
running Python. Sources were rechecked on October 13, 2026.

| Contract | Fixture | Reference source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Workspace fields and explicit path resolution | `workspace/config.user.yaml` | [config.py](https://github.com/czl9707/build-your-own-openclaw/blob/37ae5dd255a0451609e67ad6d6a51fa5de80523c/06-web-tools/src/mybot/utils/config.py) |
| Agent frontmatter, instructions and model overrides | `workspace/agents/helper/AGENT.md` | [agent_loader.py](https://github.com/czl9707/build-your-own-openclaw/blob/37ae5dd255a0451609e67ad6d6a51fa5de80523c/06-web-tools/src/mybot/core/agent_loader.py) |
| Skill ID, metadata and body | `workspace/skills/brief/SKILL.md` | [skill_loader.py](https://github.com/czl9707/build-your-own-openclaw/blob/37ae5dd255a0451609e67ad6d6a51fa5de80523c/06-web-tools/src/mybot/core/skill_loader.py) |
| Message optionality, tool exchange and index metadata | `sessions/*.jsonl`, `index.jsonl` | [history.py](https://github.com/czl9707/build-your-own-openclaw/blob/37ae5dd255a0451609e67ad6d6a51fa5de80523c/06-web-tools/src/mybot/core/history.py) |

`reference-contracts.test.ts` opens the literal Workspace through the public
Agent interface, checks shared model fields and overrides, and loads the Skill
through the tool loop with a controlled endpoint. `history.test.ts` checks
imports, optional fields, IDs, independent literal serialization, legacy messages,
unknown extensions, and new-reader recovery. Unknown fixture fields exercise
forward compatibility. Explicit directory settings preserve the reference layout.
See the [compatibility exception record](../../../docs/phase1-acceptance.md)
for approved differences.
